# C++ vs Python head-to-head (cpp stage) - generated by summarize.py

All numbers below are from the files under `cpp/results/`. Ring rows use 1 GiB rings (L = 1 GiB // record), records of 632 B metadata + HxWx3 image, 10 s per run. `sk_head` = the real SkellyCam ring (HEAD 23ccbf20); `cpp_head_port` = the same algorithm (fresh heap temp + 2 copies) in C++; `py_seq` = numpy seqlock ring, 1 copy; `hybrid` = C++ ring called from Python via pybind11; `hybrid_ctypes` = the same C function via ctypes; `cpp_one_copy` / `cpp_proc` / `cpp_thread` = pure C++ (processes / threads).
